mirror_rule: A community node in family F is a mirror when the part of its id after the first "/" equals the repo name of an official F node under str.casefold; mirror_of is the first official id in sorted order on a tie.
notes: Research prototypes (2026-11-26) evaluated all-family and community series under this same uploader rule before this freeze; the rule was fixed in discuss-phase D-09 and not changed after any kernel was seen.
rule: A node is official for family F when F is among its families and its author (the id prefix) equals ORG[F]; only id, families, author and generation are read. is_root means generation 0 in the full network.
